title: Parity case file
description: Schema for a single parity case JSON file under rescript-mcp/parity/cases/. Catches top-level drift (operation/variant/mutating/volatileFields) without constraining per-op args shapes (those are validated at runtime by the runner).

operation.description: The facade operation to invoke. 17 v1 ops (plan 006) + 9 DDL ops (plan 034) + 6 linked-table/SQL-script ops (plan 038).

args.description: Operation-specific arguments. Shape varies per operation; validated at runtime by the runner against the live facade signature.

mutating.description: True iff the case mutates database state. The 5-op mutating registry (insert_data, update_data, delete_data, execute_raw_sql, export_data) covers the MUTATING operations; per-case `mutating: false` is allowed for non-mutating invocations (e.g. SELECT) of nominally-mutating ops. The runner uses this to decide between per-side fixture copies (mutating) and shared pristine fixture (non-mutating).

description.description: Human-readable description of what the case asserts.

volatileFields.description: Field paths dropped from the normalizer before comparison (e.g. timestamps, temp paths, primary-key inference).

setup.description: Optional array of setup operations run before the main op. Each step is {operation, args}. Cases with setup are implicitly mutating (runner enforces per-side fixture copies).

skip.description: If true, the case is skipped and excluded from matched/errored counts. Use skipReason to document why.

skipReason.description: Human-readable reason for skipping the case. Required when skip is true.
